definitions.gloss: the open sea; the wide ocean
definitions.explanation: A vast stretch of open sea, seen as a broad surface reaching to the horizon. A literary, poetic word.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}{海原|うなばら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{出|だ}す→乗り出す：05760_noridasu⟧。
examples.english: To set out onto the vast ocean.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目|め}の{前|まえ}→目の前：22588_menomae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{青|あお}い→青い：00586_aoi⟧{海原|うなばら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A blue expanse of sea stretched out before my eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{果|は}てしない→果てしない：21980_hateshinai⟧{海原|うなばら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何日|なんにち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{進|すす}み→進む：01225_susumu⟧{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: The ship sailed on for days across the endless ocean.

notes:
{海|うな} (an old form of うみ) + {原|はら} (plain, expanse). The irregular reading うな appears only in a few words like this one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大海原|おおうなばら}: the great ocean
- {青海原|あおうなばら}: the blue sea
- {海原|うなばら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{出|だ}す→乗り出す：05760_noridasu⟧: to set out across the sea (also figuratively, into the wide world)

USAGE:
Found in songs, poetry, narration and writing. In ordinary conversation, ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧ or ⟦{沖|おき}→沖：02144_oki⟧ (offshore) is used.
